**Summary:** DarQ Reborn v3.2.0 adds a new Appearance screen with themes, accent colors and a pure black mode, an easy way to report problems, and a fix for root mode failing to connect after the app is closed.

### ✨ New
- **Appearance settings**: Choose light, dark or follow system, pick an accent color (matched to your wallpaper, one of eight presets, or your own custom color), turn on pure black for AMOLED screens (with a ten step surface lift slider for the cards), and tint the settings icons with your accent. Android 10 and 11 get the preset closest to your wallpaper.
- **Fresh look**: Settings are grouped into rounded sections with round icons everywhere and a new main switch, following the current Android design.
- **Custom accent color**: Tap Custom in the accent sheet to mix your own color with the saturation and hue controls or type a hex value, with a live Light and Dark preview. The presets are shown as one tile grid, and Apply keeps the change only when you want it.
- **Report an issue**: Report a bug or suggest a feature on GitHub from the app. Type what happened and the steps, and the form opens prefilled. Bug reports include a diagnostic log by default, shown as a summary first with the full log one tap away. Your apps and location are removed from the log, and nothing is sent unless you choose to.
- **Status line**: The main switch shows whether DarQ is running through Shizuku or root, whether the service is connected and how many apps are selected, and the title bar is now compact so the list starts higher.
- **Support, developer and credits**: A Support development row with a red heart that opens a sheet (UPI, PayPal, GitHub Sponsors), a developer sheet with verified links, and a Credits sheet that thanks Kieron Quinn and the projects DarQ builds on.
- **Track with Obtainium**: Add DarQ to Obtainium in one tap from Settings or the update sheet.
- **Crash reports**: If DarQ closes unexpectedly, it offers the saved report the next time you open it, once.

### 🛠️ Bug Fixes & Improvements
- **Faster app list**: The app picker opens instantly and only refreshes apps that were installed, updated or removed. It now groups apps under letters, animates changes and offers Clear search when nothing matches.
- **Polish**: Every dialog shares one look, rows and swatches react to touch, links always open in your default browser, toasts no longer pile up, and predictive back is supported on Android 14 and later.
- **Translations**: New screens are translated into Ukrainian and Simplified Chinese with machine translation, so wording may not be perfect.
- **Root mode connection**: Fixed DarQ getting stuck on "Service Timeout" in root mode after the app was closed or force-stopped.
- **Xposed support**: Works with LSPosed 1.9.2, its maintained forks and Vector. The newer LSPosed 2.x format is built in and will be switched on in a later release.

### 🧪 Testing
- Tested on Android 10 to 17 in Shizuku, root and Xposed (LSPosed and Vector) modes, including a Galaxy S24 Ultra and Galaxy Tab S10 Ultra.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Arora-Sir/DarQ-Reborn/compare/v3.1.11...v3.2.0
